scope: Index checks in the collision loader and the three renderers' world loaders, decided on and proven against every map of every installed game: an offline measurement of every index, a load of every map before and after the change in each renderer, and the damaged maps of the 2026-09-26 record again.

before.source: 3fe5f45 (HEAD), built from a clean working tree with every development gate on
before.platform: Windows 11 x64 host, Windows x86 build: meson/build/win32-dev, MSVC 19.44, debugoptimized, strict warnings, renderers glx/vk/rtx as modules; every development gate on (RTCW, WolfET, Elite Force, Q3 IHV, Jedi Academy, Jedi Outcast, Alice, F.A.K.K.2, Medal of Honor, Q3Test)

after.source: 3fe5f45 with this change, built from the working tree

installations.q3test: .tmp/q3test/install (one folder per release, laid down from the six Win32 packages)

environment: Windowed on unswitched private desktops (tests/windows_private_process.py), one fresh process and isolated fs_homepath per load, empty configurations under every profile name in the home, sound and mouse/joystick input disabled, Steam integration and the WebUI off, networking off, console commands only. Retail installations were read, never written.
